mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing fair conditions and a comfortable 70 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. If you are up late, keep an eye on the sky at 4:19 AM tonight for a four-minute pass of the International Space Station rising near Verona High School and moving toward Fitchburg.

The City of Verona has installed a new piece of public art titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics in Century School Park. Carved from a reclaimed ash tree by local artists, the sculpture features animals inspired by traditional Tai Chi movements and is designed to be an inclusive space for the community.

We have plenty to do this week in Verona. Today you can drop in for Yoga at Insight Wellness or join the fun at Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and on September 5, you can head downtown for the Dane County Farmer's Market.

Regarding the police report, on August 30, officers were dispatched to the 800 block of North Edge Trail after a vehicle window was intentionally smashed. The suspect, who was on probation, has an active arrest warrant and the department is actively searching for him.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The Culver's in Verona opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving up treats until 10:00 PM.
